- [ ] I updated to the latest version and can reproduce the bug there

**Describe the bug**
Please describe how you encountered the bug, what you expected, and what actually happened.

**Steps to Reproduce**
Explain what exacts commands you ran before seeing the bug or provide a python code snippet.

If you do not know what to put here, please check out [How to Send Bug Reports Effectively](https://www.chiark.greenend.org.uk/~sgtatham/bugs.html).

**Sample files (optional)**
If you have example VASP or other files that trigger the bug, please share them. **Do not share POTCARs - VASP license does not allow that**.
